_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of hosts.
Here am I; send me.
The whole earth is full of his glory.
Here am I; send me.
Put out into the deep water and let down your nets.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: The temple shakes, the room fills with smoke, and a voice cries Holy across the thresholds.
Here am I, Lord; send me.
Who am I to stand here, a person of unclean lips — and yet a coal of mercy touches me clean.
Here am I, Lord; send me.
And on a lake, tired fishermen who caught nothing all night are told: try again, deeper.
Here am I, Lord; send me.
The nets break with abundance; the unworthy are called; do not be afraid.
Here am I, Lord; send me!
